## Before you start {.study}

- **You need:** a phone or a computer with a browser. Nothing to install.
- **How it works:** watch the video of your teacher on the e-learning
  platform. Then do each Step on its simulator.
- **You submit:** the **tasks PDF** with your answers, before lecture 5.
  About 30 minutes.

## Key terms {.study}

{{< glossary heading-style table-of-contents header-footer page-number pdf >}}

## Step 1 · A table of contents {.study}

- Give each heading the style **Heading 1** (**Home › Styles**).
- Click in the empty line under the title.
- **References › Table of Contents › Automatic Table 1**: Word lists the
  headings and their pages.

{{< sim file="sims/word-lab-toc.html" poster="sims/word-lab-toc.png" title="Word Lab: headings and a table of contents" height="760" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · The contents"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Bold|Title"}
The heading *Prices* is not in the table of contents. Which style does it need?
:   Heading 1

    Why: Word puts only the lines with a heading style in the contents.
:::
:::

## Step 2 · A header and page numbers {.study}

- **Insert › Header › Blank**: type the header once. It is on **every
  page**.
- **Insert › Page Number › Bottom of Page › Plain Number 2**: Word counts
  the pages by itself.

{{< sim file="sims/word-lab-header.html" poster="sims/word-lab-header.png" title="Word Lab: a header and page numbers" height="760" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Every page"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="only on page 1|only on page 5"}
A report has 5 pages. You type the header on page 1. On how many pages is the header?
:   on all 5 pages

    Why: The header is the same on every page.
:::
:::

## Step 3 · Save the report as a PDF {.study}

- A **PDF** looks the same on every phone and computer.
- **File › Save As**, then **Save as type: PDF (\*.pdf)**, then **Save**.

{{< sim file="sims/word-lab-pdf.html" poster="sims/word-lab-pdf.png" title="Word Lab: save the report as a PDF" height="700" >}}

## Step 4 · AI can correct your report {.study}

Only look and try here: the tasks do not need AI.

- On **tutudocs.com** (no sign-in) open the report, then **AI Assistant**.
- Ask for one change, for example *Fix the spelling mistakes.*
- **File › Download › Microsoft Word (.docx)**: the new report.

{{< sim file="sims/tutu-online.html" poster="sims/tutu-online.png" title="Tutu Lab: AI corrects and adds to the report" height="700" >}}

## Tasks to submit {.tasks}

### Task 1 · Tap the answer

::: {.pick}
**a)** Word makes the **table of contents** from …

- the **bold** words
- the **heading styles**
- the first line of each page
:::

::: {.pick}
**b)** You type the **header** on page 1. Where is it?

- only on page 1
- on **every page**
- only on the last page
:::

::: {.pick}
**c)** What is good about a **PDF**?

- It looks the same on every device.
- It has a bigger font.
- It has no pages.
:::

::: {.pick}
**d)** In Step 4 the AI changes *askd* to *asked*. What did it fix?

- the colour
- the size
- the spelling
:::
